crossRefs.note: Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.
The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.
The sluggard says, “There is a lion outside! I will be killed in the streets!”

translations.web: He who observes the wind won’t sow; and he who regards the clouds won’t reap.
translations.bsb: He who watches the wind will fail to sow, and he who observes the clouds will fail to reap.
translations.kjv: He that observeth the wind shall not sow; and he that regardeth the clouds shall not reap.
translations.asv: He that observeth the wind shall not sow; and he that regardeth the clouds shall not reap.
